Fix solve(facts): return {"allowed": bool}. Access requires active actor, resource tenant equal actor tenant, AND actor is owner OR actor role admin. A tenant admin has no cross-tenant exception. Missing/unknown role gives no admin right.

Fix solve(facts): normalize intervals into sorted nonoverlapping half-open intervals. Ignore empty intervals, reject reversed endpoints with {"error":"reversed"}. Merge overlap but never merge mere adjacency. Return {"intervals": [[start,end],...]}. Input may be unsorted/duplicated and have negative endpoints.

Fix solve(facts): ledger events credit/debit positive integer amount with event id. First occurrence of an id takes effect; exact duplicates ignored; same id with different kind/amount rejects entire batch with {"error":"conflict"}. Balance starts at initial. Debit may overdraw (negative balance allowed). Return {"balance": int,"applied": int} counting unique events. No input mutation.

Fix solve(facts): amount_cents nonnegative integer and percent exact decimal string [0,100]. Discounted amount = amount_cents*(1-percent/100), rounded HALF UP to integer cents, never binary-float/bankers rounding. Return {"cents": int}.

Fix solve(facts): validate entire rows before converting. Duplicate id rejects batch with {"error":"duplicate"}. Missing name rejects with {"error":"missing_name"} (duplicate check has precedence). Otherwise return {"rows": rows sorted by id, each exactly id and display_name preserving name string}. Do not mutate input.
